newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: D&P gives S.Africa Umgeni Water high credit rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P gives S.Africa Umgeni Water high credit rating.

text.p: International rating agency Duff & Phelps said on Wednesday it had accorded Umgeni Water's long term rand denominated stock a rating of AA+.
"This is defined as an organisation with a very strong capacity to ensure timely repayment of its long term domestic debt obligations," it said in a statement.
Umgeni had also received the highest possible short term credit rating of D1+.
The rating was accorded ahead of Umgeni's imminent new bond issue and was expected to favourably impact on the price.

Umgeni's new borrowings over the next five years are expected to be in the region of 2.5 billion rand in order to fund a major capital expenditure programme associated with growing population demands and extension of water services to rural communities.
Its low business risk, by virtue of the low price elasticity of its life sustaining product, and its statutorily entrenched monopoly position influenced the rating, Duff & Phelps said.
